$comment: What side-by-side.sh may find different between the open-source edition and Ratel Cloud at the synced commit (temporary parity harness, RTL-45). `natural`: differences that are meant to be there, each with the natural difference it stands for; a matching line is left out of the report. `audit`: the audit's known items, used only to put an item number beside a reported line; they still fail the run, and a fix removes its entries. A reported line that matches neither is a difference the audit did not find. An entry matches one difference line: `check` (schema, seed, rows, mcp, pages), optionally `part` (a regular expression on the page or call name) and `side` (cloud or here), and `pattern` (a regular expression on the line).
